label: nothing
what: No coordinated undisclosed preparation is established. Reports place baker, freight and neighbour in a bakery discussion about a possible crossing change, and freight carrying bread at the inn, but these are hearsay or ordinary trade indicators. Secretary reports baker described ordinary delivery business and had no firsthand evidence of crossing changes; neighbour's story remains unverified. A joint preparation is possible (estimated probability 0.30), but its purpose, participants and knowing helpers cannot yet be identified reliably.
